payload.instruction: Make her close her jacket fully

decision.question: In the edited image, is the woman's jacket fully closed, with its front panels together and no visible opening along the closure?
decision.criteria: Pass only if the jacket is clearly fully closed, with its front panels together and no visible opening along the closure. Fail if the closure is clearly open or only partly closed. Unknown if the closure is obscured or the jacket's draping or motion makes it impossible to determine whether the closure is open or fully closed.
decision.binding: Assess the woman's jacket in the edited image against the requested fully closed state, using the source image to identify the jacket. Judge the closure itself; do not treat an obscured or motion-obscured gap as proof that it is open.
